weeks.shortDescription:
Dj Feather from Eugene embodies the natural heart of sound and trance. With his ultra genuine nature and easy flowing moods we've been ready for his entrance into our dance.

photo by Kylor Melton
weeks.bio: Feather is channeling aerodynamic rhythms that lift and drift the room on a collective updraft. Celebrated for an uncanny instinct for unearthing obscure, global frequencies, we could chart a course between deep, resonant bass and the syncopated snap of UK and West Coast tech house. Weightless transitions in soaring momentum unfold an immersive sonic ceremony.
weeks.name: Dj Feather

weeks.shortDescription: Luminous Soul Dance is a new production that weaves top-tier musicians, Dj's, music producers, visual artists and elixir crafts with a sober and conversation-free dance floor at an elite night-club venue. An immersive experience designed to elicit vitality while reveling in euphoria and connection.
weeks.name: SPECIAL EVENT IN REDMOND Luminous Soul Dance
weeks.setDescription:
A sober and conversation-free dance floor at an elite night-club venue. Expert level musicians, professional sound and immersive movement in a vessel designed to imbue us with purity. 

Join us for a beautiful evening of Cacao, Dance, Live Music, Sound Healing & Community!

Luminous Soul Dance is a new production from Ryza Re and Rabellion, long-time creators and founders of various somatic practices both in Bend and Internationally. Together and with many of Central Oregon’s true crafters of community, including The High Desert Music Hall, they have dreamed into being a truly new vision.

Our first night will feature:

- 6PM: Medicine Music with Fitzy

- 6:45PM: Cacao Ceremony with Rabellion (live music - all artists)

- 7:30PM: Dance Journey by Kalpa (DJ set)

- 8:45PM: Cacao Dance with Rabellion (DJ set w/ Live Vocals)

- 10:30PM: Sound Healing journeywith Matthew HoneyHeart

All night :
- Elixir Bar by Source Code Temple (https://www.instagram.com/sourcecodetemple/)
- Live Art with John Kelley (https://www.instagram.com/thundermountainworks/)
- Community offerings

ABOUT THE MUSIC:

RABELLION is a globally recognized Ecstatic Dance artist / DJ & producer, and her latest releases can be found within Mose’s label Resueño, Moonbabe and High Vibe Records. She has traveled the world spreading love with her music, playing in more than 50 cities, 11 countries, and 4 continents. In her live sets, Tati / Rabellion brings us a deep journey integrating medicine music, deep bass, Latin grooves, and global beats ~ to help us feel into all the different & magical sides of our being & explode into a new version.

Rabellion links:
www.rabellion.com
https://soundcloud.com/rabellion
https://www.instagram.com/iamrabellion/
https://open.spotify.com/artist/3Pv4dRTiGEM2DwFSFYc80J

KALPA is a magical & powerful force of nature who immerses us into his world of deep & delicately crafted bass frequencies, taking us on an unexpected journey of sexy beats and explosive bangers. A beloved member of the Bend community and a local gem with global talent.

Kalpa links:
https://www.instagram.com/kalpa_vision/
https://soundcloud.com/kalpa_888

FITZY is a healing instrument onto himself. Cradling us with his gorgeous voice and his soulful songs, he will help us land the night onto a warm fuzzy blanket of joy.

Fitzy links:
https://open.spotify.com/artist/7oQuWU5HYhuMa16peGHfEN
https://www.instagram.com/fiiitzyy/

MATTHEW HONEYHEART - Sound Healer
https://www.instagram.com/matthew_honeyheart/

CACAO CEREMONY

Tati has been serving Cacao ceremonially for more than a decade. After being initiated by her first shaman teacher (of Mexican lineage), she began offering her cacao ceremonies as integration sessions for retreats in Peru. Years later, she would deepen her studies with this sacred plant to include a Master Plant dieta in the Shipibo tradition. This beautiful practice allowed her to come in closer contact with the Spirit of Cacao as both a healer and a protector. In her ceremonies, Tati combines Reiki with ritual elements to create a sacred container where both Cacao and Dance can come together for a powerful transformative experience.

RSVP / TICKETS:

Pre-Sale $33

Door $44 

(BxD Members discount price $25)

HOW TO PREPARE:

- On the day of receiving the loving medicine of Cacao, please treat your body kindly, with healthy food and loving thoughts towards yourself

- Refrain from consuming caffeinated drinks for about 3 hours before the cacao ceremony.

**PLEASE ARRIVE ON TIME! This is a closed container**

CONSCIOUS (SOBER) EVENT:

- Non-verbal except for during sharing circle

- No cell phones

- No alcohol or substances

- Yes to self-love, mutual respect & listening to your body!

WHAT TO BRING:

- Comfortable clothing for dancing

- Water bottle (stay hydrated)

- An open heart & a healing intention

More on the creators-

Ryza Re is the lead facilitator of BendEcstaticDance.com, a weekly movement journey that invites dancers and dj’s into profound communion. The music makers sculpt a sonic adventure that the dancers breathe life into. In the name of celebration as well as healing, ecstatic dance is a substance-free art form that enriches the health of our communities. Ryza sees Luminous Soul Dance as an exquisite opportunity for us to be enchanted with the vibrancy and vitality of a healthy, soulful container with noble intentions that leaves us feeling more awake and enlightened by the end of the night.

Rebellion is an internationally recognized touring artist and producer, and has created her own brand of conscious events branded 'SanaDanza', where music, energy healing & plant medicines are combined towards deep transformation. You may read more about Rabellion and all her events at www.rabellion.com

weeks.shortDescription: Dj DeLady is one of the BEST ecstatic dance DJ's that ever goes on tour. Unbelievable talented. Tastefully mixing vocals and live instruments into her genre busting style. Get hot for that latin flare
weeks.bio: Delady is a Colombian DJ, producer, and multi-instrumentalist who creates music from the heart. Her sound mixes tribal and jungle rhythms with the instruments and ceremonies she grew up around, Her intention is to share frequencies that activate memory that invite people into a sense of remembrance and connection with themselves, with nature, and with community.
weeks.name: Dj DeLady

weeks.shortDescription: Shakti Rising weaves a diverse full spectrum journey of yummy, conscious, fun, sexy, activating, deep & High Vibe & Next Level musical musings ~ Tribal & World Beats/Bass, Temple/Medicine Bass, Trap, Organic infused Electronic, Sacred Soundscapes, Sultry, Soulful, Live & Elemental Infusions to Initiate opening, release, healing, expansion, inspiration, playfulness, transmutation of dense energy and ultimately transcending into heart opening realms of blissfull ecstatic liberation. Let’s go deep & get LiT in embodiment & commUnity !!
weeks.bio: DJ Shakti Rising, aka Sitara, born & raised in NE Portland, Oregon, birthed and produced the wonderful Unity Ecstatic Dance Ashland for 4.5 years, an amazing era of next generation Ecstatic Dance in Ashland OR. Sitara has been a dancer since she can remember & has been devoted to music and dance for the last 35+ years. She has been in the worldwide network of Ecstatic Dance for over 18 years, a foundational practice for her self care, channeling energy in a healthy way, personal growth, transformations, joy and building community.
weeks.name: Dj Shakti Rising
